content.text: Support runbook added; feature flag removed after two weeks stable.
Cross-workspace visibility today requires dual membership and manual sync. Some programs need a single list column visible elsewhere without granting write access.

From a list column menu, “Mirror to workspace…” creates a read-only mirrored column in a target workspace the actor admins. Card titles, status, and assignees replicate one-way within 2 minutes; edits in the source propagate, edits in the mirror are rejected. Break-mirror is available on either side with confirmation.
Released when audit logs record mirror create/break, attachments are metadata-only (no binary clone) in v1, and cycle detection blocks A→B→A setups.
